local self=require('openmw.self')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local t=0;local observed=false
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 if not observed then
  local current=core.weather.getCurrent(self.cell);local nextWeather=core.weather.getNext(self.cell)
  if current then
   print(string.format('KvatchWeather first current=%s next=%s factor=%.9g paused=%s',current.name,nextWeather and nextWeather.name or 'none',core.weather.getTransition(self.cell),tostring(core.isWorldPaused())))
   observed=true
  end
 end
 t=t+dt;if t<.2 then return end;t=0
 assert(not types.Actor.isDead(self),'Player died on first Kvatch gate approach')
 if core.isWorldPaused() then return end
 if self.position.x < -140000 and self.position.y > -20000 and self.position.y < -14000 then
  local gate=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x01e8a3))
  print('KvatchWeather original approach control ready position='..tostring(self.position)..' gateValid='..tostring(gate:isValid()))
 end
end}}}}
